name: Pending Reason 28 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is pending settlement. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is still possible.

AWMO.name: Awaiting Money
AWMO.definition: Financial instruments are delivered, but still awaiting money from counterparty.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Instruction was received after the account servicer's deadline. Processed on best effort basis.

CAIS.name: Awaiting Securities
CAIS.definition: Awaiting financial instruments from a corporate action or other procedure, for example, conversion, dematerialisation, exchange, registration, stamping, splitting.

REFU.name: Instruction Refused Or Not Recognised
REFU.definition: Instruction has been refused or not recognised and is represented automatically.

AWSH.name: Awaiting Securities From Counterparty
AWSH.definition: Financial instruments have not yet been received from the counterparty (if receive against payment trade), the money has been delivered.

PHSE.name: Physical Delivery Delay
PHSE.definition: Settlement is physical. Financial instruments are being delivered.

TAMM.name: Trade Amended In Market
TAMM.definition: Trade is being amended in the market.

DOCY.name: Awaiting Documents Or Endorsements From You
DOCY.definition: Awaiting documents or endorsements from you.

DOCC.name: Awaiting Documents Or Endorsements From Counterparty
DOCC.definition: Awaiting documents or endorsements from counterparty.

BLOC.name: Account Blocked
BLOC.definition: Your account is blocked, no instruction can settle over the account.

NEWI.name: New Issues
NEWI.definition: Financial instrument is a new issue and not yet available/tradable.

CLAC.name: Counterparty Insufficient Securities
CLAC.definition: Insufficient deliverable financial instruments in counterparty's account or counterparty does not hold financial instruments.

MUNO.name: Multiple Settlement Amount
MUNO.definition: Quantity instructed is not a multiple of an existing settlement quantity lot for the financial instrument.

GLOB.name: Global Form Securities
GLOB.definition: Settlement cannot be executed; financial instruments are in global form.

PREA.name: Your Instruction On Hold
PREA.definition: Your instruction is a preadvice, that is, for matching only.

NMAS.name: No Matching Required
NMAS.definition: Instruction has not been matched; matching process is not required.

NOFX.name: No Foreign Exchange Instruction
NOFX.definition: A foreign exchange instruction from you is missing.

YCOL.name: Collateral Shortage
YCOL.definition: Insufficient collateral in your account to execute the instruction.

COLL.name: Securities Pledged As Collateral
COLL.definition: Financial instruments are not deliverable as they are pledged as collateral.

DEPO.name: Refused Deposit For Issue Of Depositary Receipts
DEPO.definition: Deposit of shares for the issuing of depositary receipts has been refused. The allotment granted by the issuer is exceeded by your transaction.

FLIM.name: Maximum Foreign Limit Reached
FLIM.definition: Insufficient deliverable financial instruments in your account as maximum foreign limit has been reached.

INCA.name: Income Adjustement Required
INCA.definition: Financial instruments require income adjustment, for example, dividend or interest.

LINK.name: Pending Linked Instruction
LINK.definition: Your instruction is pending settlement because the instruction linked to it is pending.

FUTU.name: Awaiting Settlement Date
FUTU.definition: Awaiting settlement date. No settlement problems to be reported.

LACK.name: Lack Of Securities
LACK.definition: Insufficient financial instruments in your account.

LALO.name: Securities Loaned Out
LALO.definition: Financial instruments are out on loan.

NCON.name: Confirmation Not Received
NCON.definition: Confirmation of settlement has not yet been received.

REFS.name: Not In Good Order
REFS.definition: Delivery/receipt was refused because physical financial instruments are not in good order.

BATC.name: Processing Batch Difference
BATC.definition: Processing batch differs in the counterparty's instruction, for example, daytime/real-time versus overnight.

CYCL.name: Awaiting Next Settlement Cycle
CYCL.definition: Your instruction is confirmed in the local market or is ready for settlement, awaiting next settlement cycle.

SBLO.name: Securities Blocked
SBLO.definition: Financial instruments are blocked due to a corporate action event, realignment, etc.

CPEC.name: Counterparty In Receivership
CPEC.definition: Counterparty is in receivership (form of bankruptcy where a court appointed person - the receiver - manages the affairs of the business).

MINO.name: Minimum Settlement Amount
MINO.definition: Quantity instructed is lower than the minimum existing settlement quantity for the financial instrument.

PHCK.name: Physical Securities Verification
PHCK.definition: Physical financial instruments have been received and are being checked for authenticity.

BOTH.name: Both Instructions On Hold
BOTH.definition: Counterparty's instruction and your instruction are on hold/frozen/ in a preadvice mode.

CLHT.name: Clearing House Trade
CLHT.definition: Instructed settlement date does not agree with the settlement date on the clearing house trade, that is, a specific type of trade in India.

DENO.name: Unavailable Deliverable Denominated Quantity
DENO.definition: Quantity instructed does not match the denomination available/deliverable. Physical securities need to be obtained in deliverable denominated quantities.

DISA.name: Natural Disaster
DISA.definition: Exceptional closing of all financial institutions due to natural disaster, for example, earthquake.

DKNY.name: Counterparty Returned Shares
DKNY.definition: Counterparty has returned or refuses the securities.

FROZ.name: Securities Frozen At CSD
FROZ.definition: Financial instruments are blocked at the Central Security Depository (CSD) following a corporate event.

LAAW.name: Awaiting Other Transaction
LAAW.definition: Awaiting settlement of a purchase to cover failing positions.

LATE.name: Market Deadline Missed
LATE.definition: Instruction was received after market deadline.

PRCY.name: Counterparty Instruction On Hold
PRCY.definition: Counterparty's instruction is a preadvice, that is, for matching only.

REGT.name: Certificates Rejected
REGT.definition: Certificates have been lodged with the registrar but rejected due to incomplete documentation or foreign ownership limitation reached.

SETS.name: Settlement System Method Modified
SETS.definition: Settlement system/method has been modified at central securities depository to allow settlement.

PRSY.name: System On Hold
PRSY.definition: Transaction was put on hold/frozen by the system.

CSDH.name: CSD Hold
CSDH.definition: Central securities depository sets the instruction in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode.

CVAL.name: CSD Validation
CVAL.definition: Instruction is in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode as it fulfils predefined conditions of a restriction processing type in the market infrastructure platform.

CDLR.name: Conditional Delivery Awaiting Release
CDLR.definition: Instruction is in a hold/frozen/preadvice mode. Market infrastructure platform is awaiting release.

INBC.name: Incomplete Number Count
INBC.definition: Not all the instructions part of a pool have been received.

PATD.name: Partial Differ
PATD.definition: Disagreement on partial indicator preventing partial settlement.
